name: marker
useFor: Use to mark time or state in a conversation or a log: separator for a day (Today), unread for where new messages start, border for a heading over a group. Put a lucide glyph in MarkerIcon and the words in MarkerContent.
constraints: Colors other than muted ink and the blue
source: Extrapolated from opencommerce (window bar and chart labels in the platform mono)

examples.content:
import { Clock, Inbox } from "lucide-react"; import { Marker, MarkerContent, MarkerIcon } from "@/components/ui/marker"; export function Site() { return (
Today 3 new updates Order #A-10293 Checkout took 9s. See the route
); }

title: Marker
description: A small mono label in a conversation or list: plain, centered between rules, ruled underneath, or the blue unread rule.
